metadata.description: Story DNA Narrative Characteristics Dataset for CineMatch

traits.name: Plot Twists & Revelations
traits.description: Unpredictable story turns, third-act reveals, and reality-altering shocks.

traits.name: Slow-Burn Storytelling
traits.description: Deliberate pacing, atmospheric tension, and gradual accumulation of dramatic weight.

traits.name: Nonlinear Timelines
traits.description: Fragmented chronology, flashbacks, looping structures, and intercut time periods.

traits.name: Unreliable Narrators
traits.description: Subjective reality, distorted perspectives, delusion, or intentional deception by the storyteller.

traits.name: Character Transformation
traits.description: Profound moral, psychological, or existential evolution across the protagonist journey.

traits.name: Psychological Depth
traits.description: Intense interiority, obsession, existential dread, trauma, and complex moral dilemmas.

traits.name: Mystery & Hidden Clues
traits.description: Investigative riddles, procedural deduction, breadcrumb clues, and intellectual puzzles.

traits.name: Parallel Storylines
traits.description: Ensemble casts, interwoven fates, multi-strand narratives, and hyperlinked storytelling.

traits.name: Emotion-Driven Storytelling
traits.description: Deeply moving narratives emphasizing grief, love, empathy, bittersweet longing, and heart.

traits.name: Open-Ended Conclusions
traits.description: Ambiguous finales, unanswered questions, interpretative endings, and thought-provoking fades.
